# HTML starter templates

Each template is a valid HTML starting point with editorial prompts in comments. Replace the example copy and remove sections that do not serve the reader.

## Use

1. Select the closest pattern.
2. Define the audience and desired outcome.
3. Replace all bracketed editorial placeholders.
4. Delete optional sections that are not useful.
5. Update the stylesheet path if the file moves.
6. Run `python scripts/validate_package.py`.
7. Test the rendered page with keyboard, zoom, and a narrow viewport.

Templates are not finished content and should never be shipped with placeholder copy.
